mechanism.reason: one-degree-of-freedom submechanisms, flat stock, inspectable pivots, direct hard stops, and no compound anatomical joint claim

scapular_stage.passive_retention: M8 clamp screw plus spring-biased neutral indexing plunger; neither electrical power nor software is required to retain the carriage
scapular_stage.secondary_retention: all four M10 pivot shoulder bolts use prevailing-torque all-metal locknuts and captured washers

humeral_stage.passive_retention: spring-biased 8 mm indexing plunger into 15 degree sector holes; maximum free interval 15 degrees
humeral_stage.secondary_retention: 6 mm steel tether rated not less than 1 kN between hub and carriage; tether is not the primary retainer
humeral_stage.drive_interface: removable umbilical-powered low-speed actuator may drive the 8 mm keyed input; actuator selection is outside the fabricated load path
